name: Tanaka Kouhei
source:
The protagonist's childhood friend.
His dream of being a famous soccer player was granted and he went to Italy for a while.
He was shown on television and became a popular player with many female fans. But he himself is bewildered by all the attention.
He's seemed to have matured a lot in the past two years.
translation:
The protagonist's childhood friend.
His dream of being a famous soccer player was granted and he went to Italy for a while.

He's seemed to have matured a lot in the past two years.
